messages:
erin_pm: Quick sync — we need a concrete rollout plan for the new routing-fallbacks feature. Targets: hosted API + Dedicated first, Private later. Main asks: feature flag naming, canary slices, A/B vs canary, regional staging order, clear rollback triggers. Hoping to finalize by EOD tomorrow.

maya_prod: +1. My priority is minimizing customer impact for high-traffic tenants. Suggest a 3-step: shadow -> 1% canary -> 25% ramp with telemetry gates.

sam_eng: I can own the canary infra. Proposal: run canaries in us-west-2 first (lower QPS peak), then eu-west-1, then ashburn. Each step is 2h bake with automated checks (latency, error-rate, tail-p99).

li_sre: Add SLO police: if p99 latency increases > 25% or API errors > 0.5% absolute for 5m, auto-cut traffic back to previous variant. Also require warmup for KV cache — cold starts will spike.

jordan_support: From support: include an opt-in for 10 enterprise customers to test early, and provide a quick rollback contact list. They want a canned customer-facing status blurb.

maya_prod: For A/B vs canary — recommend canary for infra-sensitive metrics, A/B for UX metrics only. We should not mix both in the same cohort.

devops: Flag naming rules: `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1` with sub-keys for `region`, `slice_pct`, `ttl`. Add an immediate `ff.routing_fallbacks.kill_switch` boolean for fast off. Example config snippet:```json
{
  "ff.routing_fallbacks.v1": true,
  "ff.routing_fallbacks.slice_pct": 1,
  "ff.routing_fallbacks.kill_switch": false
}
```

sam_eng: For telemetry gates I propose these thresholds (baked automaticamente):
- latency_p95 delta <= 15%
- error_rate delta <= 0.2% absolute
- CPU/GPU host saturation < 70%
If any violated, traffic drops to snapshot previous config.

li_sre: Also implement a staged rollback ladder: soft rollback (reduce to 0.1%) -> full rollback for the slice -> global rollback. Soft rollback should be automated, full rollback manual with on-call approval.

jordan_support: I'll draft the customer blurb and rollout FAQ. Can we add a subscription for support alerts when canary hits customers in their org?

erin_pm: Decisions captured: 1) Canary-first (us-west-2 -> eu -> ashburn). 2) 3-step ramp (shadow -> 1% -> 25% bake). 3) Telemetry gates + auto-soft-rollback. 4) Feature flag naming + kill-switch. 5) Enterprise opt-in cohort and support blurb.

ops-bot: deploy-ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-9876 — runbook attached. (assigned: sam_eng, li_sre, devops)

maya_prod: Action items: sam -> canary automation + rollout script, li -> SRE gate implementation, devops -> flag wiring + kill-switch, jordan -> customer comms, erin -> sign-off after dry-run. Target dry-run Friday 09:00 PST.

sam_eng: I'll push a dry-run PR tomorrow. Will include a dry-run toggle that does not affect production routing but exercises rollout logic.

erin_pm: Great. If anyone sees missing pieces call it out now or DM me. :thumbsup:
